steps.text: Who ever thought it'd snow like this?
The field's ridges have been covered with a thick layer of despair-inducing white. The bits of yellow dotting it are the heads of grain that were laboriously planted only a month prior.
How many plants would still be alive after ten days? One dares not think.
A musbeast stumbles around, barging into the silent field of wheat.

Even the sparse crops in front of it are an unexpected joy. It sniffs around carefully, calculating how much it needs to tide it over and how much would be left to take back to the cave to feed its kin.
Until a thick metal hoe crashes down on its spine.
Three more heads of wheat are gone.

The angry farmer snatches the beast that has been ruining the crops, so angry that he wants to skin it to make a meal. However, the carcass is so emaciated that it hardly weighs more than a few taels.
With a long sigh, the farmer digs a hole in the ground and buries the beast's body.
Poor thing.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Hardship strikes at will. Such occurrences are common.
If the wheat dies in this freeze, how many people will perish next year?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: A great many.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: But there will also be many who come to their aid, and a lot of them will survive.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Life itself will not cease.
The firmament is as a veil.
The ethereal satin-silk seems to be infinitely weighty, firmly separating the two combatants and pressing towards them.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Nian, let's wrap it up.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It took a considerable amount of effort to build this heart for you. It would be a terrible shame to see it torn apart in this conflict.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You aren't in a position to be making small talk yourself. I nearly took your head off with that firecracker blast just now.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Where'd all that destructive might of yours go? Why don't you make a massive pair of scissors and cut his little fabrications to bits?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You put some effort into it too! He's about to turn your painting into papercraft!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Oh, it's my fault now?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Cut me some slack here, he just turned that big ol' firecracker I built into a pile of threads. Has he always been able to do stuff like that?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Didn't think he'd ever have the will to work on his powers over the years.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: But the question is, why does he seem to have such a good grasp of what our powers are...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hold on, is it really just one guy we're up against?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Time's almost up...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I truly would like to stick around to chat more, as rare as our reunions are. However, the unfortunate reality is that I am short on time, and must bid you farewell.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I really wish I didn't have to use this. The next time we meet, I will have to make amends.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: If we meet again, that is...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: To think you'd strike down your own sister. What a disgrace.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Shu?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I didn't think you'd just go and disappear altogether, but... Are you alright?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I sincerely hope you weren't just trying to scare us on purpose...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Think of it as a much-needed rest. Sorry for worrying you.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: And here I was wanting to see my little brother again, lo and behold the scene I come back to. Does he really not see this place as home anymore?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: ...My dear sister.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I know that look. That's the look on your face whenever you've done something wrong.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: How long has it been?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: ...Sixty-seven years.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Then, you'll have to stay for dinner. If you have anything to say, you can say it at the table.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I'm sorry, my dear sister. I can't listen to you this time.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: So, you're taking orders from someone else now, huh...?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: The one who's been behind the curtain this whole time. How much longer does he plan to stay hidden?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Whatever it is, wouldn't it be better to tell me face-to-face?
A man slowly walks forth from the distance, sauntering past the threshold of time immemorial. It is as if he has been there since the very beginning.
Time and space halt with the sound of his footsteps.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You finally decide to show yourself.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: There's a whole crowd... What a lively gathering.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You all... are still inclined to such excitement?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Wait, didn't he go insane?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: The atmosphere of our little reunion isn't quite what I expected...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What happens in the movies when a relative on the most-wanted list suddenly shows up at your doorstep?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Is he actually the real deal, or just a shadow?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Any shenanigans the weiqi failure tried to pull wouldn't surprise me at this point. It'd be a big deal if he pulled another Sui-Xiang out of his ass though...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So, what's the plan, Shu? Are we fighting?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Shangshu, Yumen, and now here... Don't you think you've gone too far?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Small sacrifices for the greater good, each unto their own. Nothing more, nothing less.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Look at all the devastated fields out there, and all the suffering people... I can't forgive you for talking like that.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Upon careful consideration, there still remain two lines of inquiry regarding who owes this debt.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Then, you stay here so we can tally it up.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: This account has been accumulating debt for over a thousand years.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You haven't been here in a long time.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: There are things I must do... There is a battlefield to the north. When the troops assemble, I must stand on the front lines.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: 'Bleached bones exposed in the wilds, where fowls sing not for a thousand li.'

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: After a thousand years of war, in the end, it is still the commoners in the fields who suffer.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You care about them a great deal.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: The people you take so lightly are actually our teachers, in the truest sense. We take after their form, find things that interest us, and only then do we find our place in the world.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We have nothing in common with them. Not a single thing.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: What is so different about us?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Feranmuts may have lives spanning tens of thousands of years, while mayflies die as quickly as they live. But in the end, we are all lives born under Heaven. Everything that has a beginning must also have an end.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Warfare and slaughter. Why exactly did you choose this path? What value do you see in it?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Law and order.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I recently learned a game, weiqi. The rules are simple, but the underlying principles are quite similar to the art of war.

spans.text: The rules are simple, but the underlying principles are quite similar to the art of war.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It has demonstrated to me a singular wisdom: as chaotic and disorderly as things may appear, master the rules, and the final outcome will fall into place.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: The final outcome that we've all been so keenly focused on.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: This dead silence... This is the outcome that you see.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Not just for us, but for all things living in these lands.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: How ironic. If death is the effect, then does that not make life itself the cause?

spans.text: How ironic. If death is the
then does that not make life itself the

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Do you never get tired of standing watch here?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Everything in existence is worthy of being cherished, just as it is now.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: All things have their time. People, beasts, mountains, water, grass, trees. They are all alike in this regard. That is the Dao the people speak of.

spans.text: All things have their time. People, beasts, mountains, water, grass, trees. They are all alike in this regard. That is the

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: The grass becomes lush and green every spring. We have come, and we have existed. Is that not enough?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: So, you've resigned yourself to this end.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: That's not what you really think.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I was simply wondering...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Have we ever lived as our true selves?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Wait, don't tell me you...?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I've been contemplating this for a long time... Calculating.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Finally... I have seen another outcome.
Not far away, a green sapling pokes its head out from underneath the snow.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I know you can see it, Shu.
The haggard man stretches out his hand, his fingertips still covered with rough callouses.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Can you read my palm for me?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: 'Endless solitude; kalpas blurred, death nigh inexorable.'

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I'm very much looking forward to that... I shall be waiting.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: ...Were you able to see her again?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You know that wouldn't be possible.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I often find myself thinking of her.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: She said that 'education is the great equalizer' and wished for every person to be able to read and write... All those schools and books are her legacy.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: In that regard, you are quite similar.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: But, these last few years, I've forgotten many things... including her.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: About the books she wrote, and the meaning held by a true name in one lone word...

spans.text: About the books she wrote, and the meaning held by a
true name in one lone word...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I can clearly recall that she once played a game with me. She wanted to tell me something during that game, but I've already forgotten what it was.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Yes... Even we cannot escape this influence.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You have regrets.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I want to find a remedy...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: A hundred and eighty-one fragments. Everyone thought... you had lost your mind.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Perhaps...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: What do you intend to do?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I wish to return to that husk. I require Its power.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I will slay It. And then I shall become It.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And using Its power, I will plot a 'great windfall' for all beings in this realm.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: It'll cost you your life.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: But the rest of you will live. And truly be yourselves...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Shu, lend me a portion of your power.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: The twelve of us, with each additional portion of strength comes another chance at victory.
The vast farmland crisscrosses, and this particular visitor places a piece on the weiqi board.
Shu opens her palm, and a handful of seeds fall onto the board.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: This must be your answer.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You reap what you sow.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: If you haven't veered off the path and really are heading towards our end, then these seeds will germinate at the right time and bear the fruit you desire.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You will have conditions for me as well.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: We can't let you keep creating problems for us.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And so concludes the discussions concerning my affairs. If there's anything else, you should speak.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You've really grown up, huh? Ready to fly the nest?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I'm a thousand years old... my dear sister.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I can't stop you.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: We had a big argument the last time I left. Could you leave me something to remember you by, this time?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You've already woven all of Dahuang into that brocade of yours. What else do you want to take from me?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: If you have a bit of remorse in there, you'd better come back alive.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Fair enough...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Dusk, can I ask one last thing from you?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: That painting... Can you give it to me up front?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How did you–

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I will take good care of it.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: And with that, consider our account settled.
Who said you could go?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You again...

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: The second Sui brother! Ni ya ting de! I knew you were behind this!

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Do you have nothing better to do? Done hiding out in your ruined temple playing your shitty game of weiqi, and now you have to come to my turf to ruin everything?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Look at the mess you've all made with your little spat here, and all the crops you've destroyed! See if I won't beat your ass right here and now!

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Watch out!
The satin-silk ignites upon contact with the incandescent white flames, reduced to smoke and ash in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Originium Arts that can reverse decomposition? When did you learn how to...? No, that's not it... This is causality?

spans.text: Originium Arts that can reverse decomposition? When did you learn how to...? No, that's not it... This is

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Hah... Let's see how many more seeds you have left to withstand my flames!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Tianshi... This might not be the best time to launch your attack.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: The Chamber of Heaven's Designs has suffered grave losses. Any more wrong moves, and Great Yan's entire northern defensive line may be imperiled.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It is more than just the demonic taint that has eyes on Yan's northern border, right?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Stop trying to scare people! I swear, I'm gonna teach you a lesson if it's the last thing I do!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Then, do you not care at all about the other long-lived among you?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You little...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Ahh... You feign lunacy to protect your mind from demonic contamination, but you've not forgotten your true purpose at all.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Weigh the pros and the cons. Surely there's no reason we shouldn't be able to come to some accord.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Until we meet again.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Is it... over...?

steps.name: Ethereal Woman
steps.text: Yes, it's all over now.

steps.name: Ethereal Woman
steps.text: You were willing to throw away your life for this project. Why?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: ...To become renowned for such a grand accomplishment.

steps.name: Ethereal Woman
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: I have a dream...

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Cities interconnected for ten thousand li, stretching to the palace of Heaven; no longer would anyone across this great land want for shelter from wind and rain.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: What is the point of being a Tianshi without any accomplishments to his name...?

steps.name: Ethereal Woman
steps.text: Must you stand head and shoulders above the rest in order to lay the bricks of the city of your dreams?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Are you... one of the Heavenly Xians?

steps.name: Ethereal Woman
steps.text: I'll trade your life for your dream.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: (Shallow breathing)

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: The Skybound White Jade Capital, of Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities... The Xian strokes my head, knots my hair, and grants eternal life...
The Skybound White Jade Capital, of Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities.
Alas, could I get mansions of ten thousand chambers, I'd shelter all the needy under Heaven, blessing them with joy.

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: You're awake?

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Don't worry, the monsters are gone.

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: You saved me...?

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: I wouldn't say that.

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: You were lying unconscious on the ground when I found you, so I went over to try to wake you up.

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: ...Duoxie.

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: You're the Old Xiangzhang of Dahuang, but the responsibility does not fall solely on your shoulders.

spans.text: of Dahuang, but the responsibility does not fall solely on your shoulders.

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: It might not necessarily be a good deal to exchange your life for the safety and stability of this place.

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: That's my choice to make... What matters is that Dahuang is safe.

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: You care a lot about this place.

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: Of course I care. I've spent most of my life here, and my roots run deep...

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Passing Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Take care of yourself. I'm off.

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: Goodbye, Shu.

steps.name: Rong Wanqing
steps.text: You deserve your freedom.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The incubator, the incubator...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The rice plant can still be saved... There's still hope for the experiment...

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Here you are...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I've found it!

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Found what?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This is the one rice plant... the one that survived the 'Wanqing' project's experimental plot.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It isn't impossible to grow crops on Originium-contaminated soil. Laoshi's experiments proved it––

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Judging from your clothes, are you a Shouye Tianshi from the Bureau? I don't think I've seen you before...

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Yes... I haven't been here very long.
The young man scratches his head in confusion, as if he has forgotten something.
It is as if he has dreamed a long dream, and the emotions from it still vaguely linger in his heart. He just can't remember the people he met or the things he encountered.
After spacing out for a spell, the young man cracks a smile.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I'm an apprentice of the Tianshi Bureau, called He Sheng. I guess I ought to call you Laoshi now too.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Hello, He Sheng...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I just discovered a very important crop... one that can grow on soil contaminated by Originium...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This has been a long-term project. As long as this crop can be widely distributed, we'll be able to reclaim tons of wasteland into usable farmland, and nobody will go hungry ever again...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It might take a while to reach that goal, maybe even a really long time, but at least, there's a glimmer of hope now.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: In that case, are you willing to devote the rest of your time to that goal?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: I wish you luck.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Do your best. I won't keep you from your research any longer. Zai gin.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Huh? You're leaving already? I was hoping to tell you a bit more about the project, and maybe get a few pointers...

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: That's alright. I trust that you'll be able to accomplish your goals.

steps.name: Kind Woman
steps.text: Zai gin.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Hmm...?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That teacher... Why does it seem like I've seen her somewhere before?

steps.name: Astute Merchant
steps.text: Off to deliver the goods, Laobo?

steps.name: Astute Merchant
steps.text: How are food prices this year?

steps.name: Elderly Farmer
steps.text: Famine year. Each catty of grain is three wen more expensive than last year.

steps.name: Astute Merchant
steps.text: I suppose when everything's accounted for, your coin sack's a bit heavier than it was last year?

steps.name: Elderly Farmer
steps.text: That's not necessarily a good thing.

steps.name: Elderly Farmer
steps.text: Farming's all about putting food on people's tables. Never heard of farming to get rich.

steps.name: Astute Merchant
steps.text: Let me teach you a method to make a little extra money. Just keep it in the back of your mind when you're selling your goods.

steps.name: Astute Merchant
steps.text: Sell your highest-quality crops locally at a normal price to increase your reputation; for your average-quality stuff, mark up the price and hire a caravan to ship it far away as a novelty product.

steps.name: Elderly Farmer
steps.text: What are you going on about? Never anything so silly.

steps.name: Elderly Farmer
steps.text: The best crops are for family and friends first. You sell the average-quality stuff, and then use the rest as feed.

steps.name: Elderly Farmer
steps.text: You youngsters have way too many sly tricks.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Where're you planning to go?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Baizao.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: After making that much trouble, you just up and leave without saying anything?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It is time to leave. Though, I also don't have Dage's martial skill. If you won't let me go, then naturally, I won't be able to leave.

spans.text: time to leave. Though, I also don't have Dage's martial skill. If you won't let me go, then naturally, I won't be able to leave.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: So, it depends on you. How unwilling are you to let me leave?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: I just wanted to ask you a question.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You said you were gonna make a deal with Yan. Were you planning to help build Dahuang up from the very beginning?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I am a merchant, and when doing business, I value mutual profit and reciprocity. If only one side profits, how would I be any different from a robber?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: If you didn't want to make an enemy out of all Yan, why did you need to do all this?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Did you two brothers really have to pick a fight with Yan?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Our sister was killed, after all.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: That said, the people of Yan harbor no animus towards us. Even if Erge sees the world as nothing more than a weiqi board, a weiqi player naturally feels some sentiment towards the pieces and equipment he's used for a long time.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: However, those sitting in the court, lurking in the shadows, must pay the price for what they've done.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: This account... must be settled eventually.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Even if your own life is on the line?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Using a twelfth to combat the whole was already a fool's errand.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: My life has already been assigned a price upon the ledger.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You really have lost it...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I still remember, a long time ago, you came to visit all of us, one by one, posing a question to each and pointing the way.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: 'What do you see in the lands of Great Yan?'

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: My answer has never changed, and I imagine the same is true for Erge.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Wo pei! Never cared for either of you bastards from the very beginning. There's no talking wisdom with you. And when the time is right, I'm still coming to beat your asses.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: My brother used to have quite the temper. Whenever he'd lose a game, he'd start throwing cups and bowls around. But weak as he was, there was never any strength behind it.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: This time, he went a bit overboard, so thank you for stepping in.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Gun kai! Get outta here already!

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Until we meet again.
